# CLI reference

flamingo 0.1.0 - AI Native Frontend Testing Toolkit

## Commands

| Command | Summary | Exit |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `flamingo audit <url>` | Health report: console errors, broken assets, layout overflow | 0 if nothing is wrong, 1 if any problem is found |
| `flamingo crawl <url>` | Click every control and report the dead ones | 0 if every control responds, 1 if any is dead |
| `flamingo scroll <url>` | Scroll the whole page and map everything on it | 0 unless the page fails to load |
| `flamingo interact <url>` | Scroll the page and exercise every control on it | 0 if everything responded, 1 if any control is dead or drops input |
| `flamingo stress <url>` | Try to break the page with hostile interaction patterns | 0 if nothing broke, 1 if any scenario triggered errors or left the page unresponsive |
| `flamingo tree <url>` | Actionable elements with click-ready coordinates | 0 always (unless the page fails to load) |
| `flamingo responsive <url>` | Horizontal-overflow audit across viewports | 0 if no viewport overflows, 1 if any does |
| `flamingo shot <url>` | Screenshot the viewport to a file | 0 on success |
| `flamingo serve` | Run the MCP server on stdio | 0 when the client closes stdin |
| `flamingo init` | Wire flamingo into this project for an AI agent | 0 on success |
| `flamingo doctor` | Check the environment and report what works here | 0 if the toolkit is usable, 1 if a required piece is missing |
| `flamingo schema` | Print the machine-readable API description as JSON | 0 always |

## `flamingo audit <url>`

Health report: console errors, broken assets, layout overflow

**Options:** `--viewports <list>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if nothing is wrong, 1 if any problem is found

```bash
flamingo audit http://localhost:3000
flamingo audit http://localhost:3000 --json | jq .details
flamingo audit https://staging.example.com --backend chrome
```

## `flamingo crawl <url>`

Click every control and report the dead ones

**Options:** `--max <n>`, `--dwell <ms>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if every control responds, 1 if any is dead

```bash
flamingo crawl http://localhost:3000
flamingo crawl http://localhost:3000 --max 50 --dwell 1200
```

## `flamingo scroll <url>`

Scroll the whole page and map everything on it

**Options:** `--max-steps <n>`, `--settle <ms>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 unless the page fails to load

```bash
flamingo scroll http://localhost:3000
flamingo scroll http://localhost:3000 --json | jq .outline
```

## `flamingo interact <url>`

Scroll the page and exercise every control on it

**Options:** `--max-controls <n>`, `--dwell <ms>`, `--no-fill`, `--include-destructive`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if everything responded, 1 if any control is dead or drops input

```bash
flamingo interact http://localhost:3000
flamingo interact http://localhost:3000 --max-controls 100 --json
```

## `flamingo stress <url>`

Try to break the page with hostile interaction patterns

**Options:** `--targets <n>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if nothing broke, 1 if any scenario triggered errors or left the page unresponsive

```bash
flamingo stress http://localhost:3000
flamingo stress http://localhost:3000 --targets 5 --json
```

## `flamingo tree <url>`

Actionable elements with click-ready coordinates

**Options:** `--max <n>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 always (unless the page fails to load)

```bash
flamingo tree http://localhost:3000 --json
flamingo tree http://localhost:3000 --max 20
```

## `flamingo responsive <url>`

Horizontal-overflow audit across viewports

**Options:** `--viewports <list>`, `--settle <ms>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if no viewport overflows, 1 if any does

```bash
flamingo responsive http://localhost:3000 --viewports 1920x1080,375x812
```

## `flamingo shot <url>`

Screenshot the viewport to a file

**Options:** `--out <path>`, `--format <png|jpeg|webp>`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 on success

```bash
flamingo shot http://localhost:3000 --out shot.png
```

## `flamingo serve`

Run the MCP server on stdio

**Options:** `--backend <name>`, `--width <n>`, `--height <n>`

**Exit:** 0 when the client closes stdin

```bash
flamingo serve
flamingo serve --backend chrome
```

## `flamingo init`

Wire flamingo into this project for an AI agent

**Options:** `--dir <path>`, `--backend <name>`, `--skill-only`, `--mcp-only`, `--force`, `--json`

**Exit:** 0 on success

```bash
flamingo init
flamingo init --backend chrome
flamingo init --dir ../my-app
```

## `flamingo doctor`

Check the environment and report what works here

**Options:** `--json`

**Exit:** 0 if the toolkit is usable, 1 if a required piece is missing

```bash
flamingo doctor
flamingo doctor --json
```

## `flamingo schema`

Print the machine-readable API description as JSON

**Exit:** 0 always

```bash
flamingo schema
flamingo schema | jq '.tools[].name'
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- |
| `0` | completed, nothing wrong found |
| `1` | completed, problems found |
| `2` | usage error |
| `3` | runtime failure (browser launch or navigation failed) |
